title: Psychology Facts
hook: 3 tricks your brain falls for every day.
facts: One: the *Forer effect*. Vague horoscopes feel written just for you.
In 1948, students rated one generic profile *4.26* out of 5.
Two: the *halo effect*. One good trait makes everything else look good.
Three: *repetition*. Hearing a claim again makes it feel truer.
